For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent 6 to 8 core processor. Those matter more than a fancy graphics card.

RAM: 16 GB is the minimum. 8 GB struggles with a browser, editor and Docker open together.
Storage: 512 GB SSD or more. Avoid anything with a hard disk.
Processor: Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 (recent generation), or an Apple M-series chip if you're open to a Mac.
Screen and keyboard: Full HD, at least 300 nits, and a comfortable keyboard. You'll stare at it for hours.
Battery: Look for 8 hours or more of real use if you work away from a plug.

You only need a graphics card if you'll train AI AI or do game development. Otherwise, put that money into RAM and build quality.
